description: This file defines an InvokeDispatcher class that handles various command requests in a platform-specific manner, primarily for Android. It routes commands to appropriate handlers, performs feature availability and permission checks, and manages communication with UI components like A2UI and Canvas. It also includes utility functions for SMS search capability and command validation.

classes.name: InvokeDispatcher
classes.description: Handles various platform-specific commands routed from the client, manages feature availability checks, and coordinates with different handlers for executing actions.

methods.name: handleInvoke
methods.description: Main method to process incoming commands; routes requests to specific handlers based on command type.

methods.name: withReadyA2ui
methods.description: Ensures A2UI is ready before executing a block of code related to A2UI commands.

methods.name: withCanvasAvailable
methods.description: Wraps execution with error handling for canvas availability issues.

methods.name: availabilityError
methods.description: Checks feature availability and permissions, returning errors if requirements are not met.
